newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Dec 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Dec 23.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
Authorities in the northern province of Shanxi and the central province of Hunan adopt measures to promote "spiritual civilisation" -- socialist ethics.
Propaganda mandarin Ding Guan'gen urges writers and artists to help invigorate art and literature.
Library opens in the central province of Hunan to mark the 103rd anniversary of the birth of the late chairman Mao Zedong.
China to deepen reform in 1997, focusing on circulation and restructuring of state assets
China Investment Bank loan return rate reaches 95 percent
Guizhou regional government orders crackdown on financial irregularities
China had more than six million mobile telephone users by end-November
Vice-Premier Qian Qichen says he has full confidence in Hong Kong's future following election of the provisional legislative council.
Ministry of Railways drafts new guidelines to improve service and make trains faster in face of growing competition from air and road traffic for passengers and freight.
The Fifth National Congress of the Chinese Writers' Association re-elects Ba Jin as president of the association.
